method_note: The workspace shell cannot reach scholarly hosts (egress allowlist) and the direct page fetcher refused these hosts. Scholarly links were confirmed through web-search indexes that returned the exact landing page or DOI with matching title and author. GitHub links were confirmed by resolving the path at the current remote commit with git. No HTTP 200 was observed directly from this session for any external URL. 'exists' means the target is confirmed to exist; it does not confirm that the page supports the claim beyond title and abstract.

noindex_decision.decision: KEEP noindex,nofollow on all three research pages
reasons: The pages are R0 candidates that say they are not peer reviewed, not published and not deployed; indexing would present them as public research.
index.html cannot link to them yet without breaking the PR #1 gate (see W03_RECONCILIATION.md), so they are not yet part of the reviewed public surface.
The PR #1 release gate holds the external domain; removing noindex is a publication decision belonging to that gate, not to this branch.
nofollow is kept so these drafts pass no ranking signal to cited third-party pages before review.
noindex_decision.reversal_condition: Remove only in the same change that links the research from index.html, updates ai/index.json and the pinned blob in tests/test_copolitic_site_r0.py, and passes the release gate.
